slides.prompt: Create one professional photorealistic streetwear lifestyle photograph using the user's uploaded product reference. Use an appropriate adult model only if the scene calls for one; do not imply a specific real-person identity or match no fixed model identity unless the user provides a separate model reference if supplied. Preserve the hero product's actual color, design, texture, proportions, packaging and visible branding as shown in the supplied reference; supporting styling may be changed without obscuring the product. Setting: sunny rose-pink brick wall with teal metal door. Action: Lean one shoulder against the wall, one knee soft, hands relaxed. Camera: eye-level three-quarter. Framing: full body. Lighting: soft late-day daylight. Background palette: rose and teal. Product priority: hoodie hem and relaxed fit. For a different brand, replace the background palette with a restrained palette that complements the product's existing visible colors and supporting styling with minimal supporting styling that complements, but does not obscure or alter, the product. Retain natural skin texture, believable anatomy and realistic material behavior. Show true garment fit, construction and fabric movement. No invented logos, text, watermark or collage. The chosen adult model and product can vary between entries.

slides.prompt: Create one photorealistic campaign photograph, not a grid. Input: ONLY the user's uploaded product reference. Campaign route: Bold creative. Creative concept: An original graphic campaign derived from product geometry and color, with tactile sets, strong visual rhythm and product use. Example art direction: Olive, cobalt and cream geometric blocks, neutral portrait key and tactile oil highlights. Example palette: olive, cobalt, cream. Derive the final colors, casting, styling and set from the supplied product. No separate outfit, model or location input is required. Choose one suitable adult model internally and keep face, hairstyle, skin tone, proportions and supporting styling consistent across this campaign. Casting may differ between campaigns. Preserve the product reference's exact design, color, material, geometry, construction, size, packaging and visible branding. Inspect actual pump, bottle finish, oil texture and real dispensing mechanism; use only features visible or stated in the supplied product. Adapt any shot involving a pump, cap, cuff, sleeve, strap, container, animal or ingredient to what actually exists; do not invent absent features, accessory products, ingredients, performance claims or internal mechanisms. Example colors and materials are creative cues: substitute the supplied product's true characteristics. Keep skin, fur, hands, fabric behavior, scale, physical contacts, reflections and shadows plausible. No captions, panel numbers, invented logos, watermark or screenshot UI. Shot R1C1: Grooming hero. Action: Hold closed pump bottle beside face with beard visible. Camera: eye-level front. Framing: head and shoulders. Where a subject is present, reuse the campaign's internally generated hero for face, animal and styling continuity. Product-only framing contains no human or animal. Full-body framing includes complete head and feet; full-animal framing includes complete head, tail and paws.
